opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. Elmar E. Grinstead for plaintiffs in error. Mr. S. P. Freéling for defendants in error.
